cues.text: Hello, little gardener! Turn the wooden gutters to join the barrel to the plants. Then let the water flow. Let's watch our garden grow!
You brought water to every garden! Look at those lovely flowers. Well done, little gardener!
Our farm friends are ready for a picnic! Move the food onto their plates. Can you give every friend an equal share?
Everyone has an equal share! What a kind picnic helper you are. Well done!

cues.text: Let's help our little friends ride home! Fit a ramp into each gap. Then send the trolley along your track. Take your time and see what happens!
Your trolley reached every little home! You built some lovely tracks. Well done, little engineer!
Let's make a farm friend from wooden shapes! Move each piece onto its outline. If a piece needs turning, choose it and turn it around.
You made three lovely farm friends from shapes! Look at them come to life. What a clever builder!
